register: Polite formal style: -습니다/-ㅂ니다 for statements and messages, -하세요 for instructions, -할까요?/-하시겠습니까? for confirmations, and bare noun phrases (사이트 추가, 저장) for buttons, menus and labels; this is what the catalog mostly uses and what Korean consumer apps use. Plain/blunt endings (-한다, -해, -함 in full sentences) are flagged.

terms.note: Catalog majority (about 720 of 1,040 story strings) uses 스토리; 기사 (~230), 글, 게시물 and 이야기 are inconsistencies. 스토리 also fits blog posts and newsletters that are not news articles. English 'article' may stay 기사. Particles do not change (스토리를/가/는/와/로). Verifier: kept 스토리. 기사 would be natural for news articles but wrong for blog posts, newsletters, podcasts and videos, and the catalog majority already uses 스토리; 글 is the only generic alternative and is too informal for labels. Also avoid where it means this concept: 기사, 게시물, 글.
Counts: 사이트 N개 or N개 사이트 both fine.
Never food. Don't use 뉴스 피드 for River of News.

avoid: 안 읽은 (tolerated only in very tight labels)
terms.note: 미읽은 is not a Korean word.
'Read Stories' (the folder of stories already read) is 읽은 스토리, never 스토리 읽기/기사 읽기 (imperative 'read stories'). Siri/Spotlight 'Read %@' opens the feed to read it: '%@ 읽기', not '읽음으로 표시'.
저장된 스토리 tolerated. Save (button) → 저장; never 구하기.
Shared Stories → 공유한 스토리 (공유된 스토리 tolerated); re-share → 다시 공유.

Product name kept in Latin script with a capital B, as the plurality of the catalog does; 블로그 loses the product name and 블러그 reads as a misspelling of 블로그. Korean has no plural, so Blurblogs → Blurblog.

Train (button) → 학습; train a site/story → 학습시키기; training → 학습 (avoid 교육, 훈련, 트레이닝); Intelligence Training → 인텔리전스 학습. 지능형 학습 is tolerated in marketing prose, but 지능 학습 ('intelligence learning') is flagged in UI labels.

Catalog majority, and matches Apple's Korean 집중 모드. Focus is the green intelligence level and the third slider position (전체/읽지 않음/집중). Focus stories → 집중 스토리. The verb 'focus or hide' may stay 강조하거나 숨기기 in prose. Also avoid where it means this concept: 중요.
Super dislike → 매우 싫어요. Thumbs up/down in prose → 좋아요/싫어요.
Prompt classifier → 프롬프트 분류기; Regex classifiers → 정규식 분류기.

Premium Archive → 프리미엄 아카이브 (avoid 프리미엄 보관함, Premium Archive); Premium Pro → 프리미엄 프로; Archive plan/tier → 아카이브 요금제; Pro plan → 프로 요금제. Plain 'archive' of stories → 아카이브; 보관 for the verb 'archive' is fine.
Preferences → 환경설정 (환경 설정 spacing tolerated); Settings → 설정.
Subscribers → 구독자; paid subscription → 구독.
뉴스 피드 collides with 'feed' and reads as the generic social news feed; lowercase 'your river' → 뉴스 스트림 or 스토리 스트림.
The reversed order reads as 'all stories of one site'. Also avoid where it means this concept: 사이트의 모든 스토리.
Catalog majority for the feature name; lowercase descriptive 'daily briefing' in prose may be 일일 브리핑.
Also avoid where it means this concept: 작가.
All three read fine in context.
Favoriting a friend's shared-story comment is a like, not a bookmark; the web error message already says 좋아요를 표시할 수 없습니다. The short Favorited/Unfavorited toasts that say 즐겨찾기 are tolerated.

The two friends-modal tabs are the standard Korean social pair: I'm Following → 팔로잉, Following Me → 팔로워 (distinguishable, as on Instagram/X). In full sentences 내가 팔로우하는 사람 / 나를 팔로우하는 사람 remain fine. Ask AI follow-up → 추가 질문.
These are sites that publish rarely, not sites the reader rarely visits. 자주 업데이트되지 않는 사이트 is tolerated.

terms.concept: Good Reads / Long Reads / Widely Read
terms.use: 좋은 글 / 긴 글 / 많이 읽힌 스토리
terms.note: Good Reads is a folder of good stories, not books.

terms.use: 피드 보기 / 텍스트 보기 / 스토리 보기 / 원본 보기
terms.note: Original site → 원본 사이트; 원문 보기 tolerated.
AI에 질문(하기) tolerated.
Sign in → 로그인.
체험판 tolerated.
Clustering is described as 묶기/그룹화 in prose; all are understandable, only misleading renderings are flagged.
NewsBlur (뉴스블러) ends in a vowel, so the particle is known.

terms.use: ASCII . , ? ! : with Korean spacing; typographic quotes “ ” ‘ ’
terms.note: Ellipsis … or ... both tolerated. Particles after placeholders whose final sound is unknown use 을(를), 이(가), 은(는), (으)로, 와(과).
